impact: Indira IVF Hospital Private Limited, which describes itself in its complaint as India’s largest fertility service provider, lost indiraivf.com on October 31, 2024, and had not noticed until January 2025. The company’s domain service provider, Global IT Providers of Jaipur, told it that the control panel “was accessed from an unfamiliar location in October 2024” and that the domain “was transferred away on October 31, 2024, without the Complainant’s authorization”. In Indira IVF’s case the threat materialised, as the decision records that “the take-over of the disputed domain name resulted in the **short suspension** of the Complainant’s website for several hours which forced the Complainant to **intervene and restore access** to its official website in order to prevent reputational and business damage”.

impact: The cyber threat detection provider warned in a social media advisories posted on October 9 that multiple groups, including the Qilin and Settra ransomware operations, are actively targeting CVE-2026-0257 to establish unauthorized VPN sessions and gain initial access to internal networks. CVE-2026-0257 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in PAN-OS GlobalProtect and Prisma Access that affects several Palo Alto Networks products, including PAN-OS versions 10.2.0, 11.1.0, 11.2.0 and 12.1.0 and two versions of Prisma Access (10.2.0 and 11.2.0). Despite these warnings, some systems appear to remain unpatched, with multiple threat intelligence teams reporting attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-0257 in recent months.

impact: The campaign, dubbed Midnight Mimosa, runs on budget Android devices from different brands built on MediaTek platforms. The malware ships in the device firmware, is present before the owner switches the phone on for the first time, and can’t be uninstalled. “The compromise is complete before the phone is first switched on,” Bitdefender noted. “The malware runs with system-level privileges that allow it to silently install and remove apps, grant permissions, and load arbitrary code supplied remotely. The campaign was observed on thousands of unique devices in more than 150 countries.
